requests.prompt:
Create the following asset: Clean policy engine evaluation flow diagram, 16:9 landscape.

Main subject:
AstralLight PolicyEngine decision flow: linear decision chain with fail-closed branches.

Composition and hierarchy:
One vertical decision chain from top to bottom: entry node, a wide dual-card check box, a projection gate diamond, then three stacked rule-source boxes, ending in a default-deny node; one short side note each for fail-closed and pending outcomes.

Visual treatment:
Clean technical architecture illustration, white background, thin vector lines, flat low-saturation fills, clear arrow direction, generous spacing.

Lighting and color:
Muted indigo, lavender, teal, sand, and charcoal on white.

On-image text:
Render only this copy, exactly and verbatim: "PolicyEngine evaluate"; "dual-card active check"; "projection READY?"; "rule-set snapshots"; "permission rules"; "delegated rules"; "DEFAULT DENY"; "PENDING"; "DENY". Language: English. Placement: Node labels centered in their boxes or diamonds; side notes in smaller regular text. Hierarchy: Short semibold node labels, smaller note text.

Requirements:
- No decorative 3D effects.
- No gradients.
- No numbered stage badges.
- All arrows must have a clear direction.
- No additional text or labels beyond the listed exact strings.
- No watermark or logo.
